title: Exploit brokers pay $500k for WordPress RCEs. I found one with GPT5.6 and $25
summary: A security researcher demonstrates finding a critical WordPress Remote Code Execution (RCE) vulnerability worth $500,000 on the exploit market, using AI-assisted research techniques at a cost of only $25, highlighting the democratization of vulnerability discovery through AI tools.
problem_solved: Demonstrates how AI can lower the barrier to entry for finding high-value security vulnerabilities, making advanced security research more accessible to researchers with limited resources.
why_valuable: This research reveals both the economic incentives driving the exploit market and the potential for AI to revolutionize security research, raising important questions about offensive security capabilities and vulnerability disclosure.
